_comment: Hand-written, like appstore/metadata/fr-FR — config.json marks fr-FR isHandWritten, so translate-copy.mjs never overwrites this file. Every string that also exists in the app is copied verbatim from Localizable.xcstrings: a screenshot showing 'Enregistrer le QR' next to an app that says 'Enregistrer le code QR' reads as a different app.
